tasks.spec: ## Repository: probe; Required behavior 4; Acceptance evidence 4; skip counterexamples and log-secret checklist. An ID remains quiet after recovery or a change in rejection reason; different loggers start fresh. Keep dedup keys free of raw records and secrets. Update README and the two specified docs. tasks.title: Every check transport and retry wait honours cancellation
tasks.spec: ## Repository: probe; Required behavior 5, Check run and Transports; Acceptance evidence 5b-5e; transport-cleanup and shared-bootstrap risks. Prepare the run-signal API before T5 supplies entry signals. Add abortable sleep and wire node:timers/promises in main; check cancellation before work, around retry waits and before HTTP hops. Pass TlsConnectOptions.signal through default and guarded TLS without changing timeout budgets, SNI or address policy. TCP/DNS entry cancellation creates no socket/Resolver. Separate CheckDeps/DomainDeps.shutdown from per-run signal; check-scheduler passes the process signal as shutdown now, and T5 combines the run signals. Update existing domain shutdown fixtures to supply shutdown explicitly, preserving their assertions and cleanup, so this task is green independently. Shared bootstrap uses only shutdown; individual waiters cancel independently and an already-aborted run never initiates refresh. Capture red/green evidence for 5b-5e, retaining the TCP in-flight control. Use the exact corrected deterministic cancellation points and cleanup assertions of 5c/5d; no external network or wall-clock polling. Update README for cancellation support; schedule replacement documentation belongs to T5.

acceptance.command: bun test src/check.test.ts src/check.tcp.test.ts src/check.dns.resolver.test.ts src/check.domain.test.ts src/check-guard.test.ts src/tls.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in the selected tests (a focused run may fail only the coverage threshold). Aborting GET during retry sleep gives exactly 1 fetch. Pre-aborted default TCP/DNS/TLS reject with the identical reason and produce 0 connections/queries; HTTP/domain make 0 fetches; guarded TLS makes 0 lookup and inner-connect calls. With fixture timeoutMs 60000, every active type's pre-aborted run returns down with 'timeout after 60000ms'. For 5d, timeoutMs is 60000: TCP aborts synchronously before any connect event (control); default TLS aborts after a silent plain-net server accepts; guarded TLS aborts after its fake inner call is recorded. Each rejects with the identical reason; abort-listener count is 0 afterwards; applicable loopback server close callbacks and accepted TLS socket close fire within the test. Guarded inner options.signal.aborted is true. The 2 domain checks share 1 pending bootstrap; aborting one waiter ends only that run, the other receives its result, and shutdown aborts the shared fetch. Red evidence against 271401b is recorded for the regression cases, with controls explicitly identified.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full test suite pass with at least 0.8 line coverage, including existing domain shutdown and single-flight controls

tasks.title: New checks start with bounded jitter and changed runs abort without overlap
tasks.spec: ## Repository: probe; Required behavior 3 and 5, Scheduler; Acceptance evidence 3, 5a and all completion evidence 6-8; Performance impact, Security impact, Rollout order and Counterexamples. Consume T4's abort-capable run API. Give each scheduler entry an AbortController; abort on replacement/removal/stop, combine its signal with process shutdown for runCheck and pass shutdown separately. Suppress expected cancellation errors and obsolete results. A replacement waits for both its sampled delay and the old in-flight run to settle; equal sync preserves its entry/timer. Implement first-run timer jitter with injected random, bounded/clamped as specified, one sample per new entry; main supplies Math.random via check-scheduler. Keep interval-from-previous-start and no-overlap through onResult. Update existing immediate-run tests with injected zero random and explicit timer advance, retaining the real-child-process main test. Update README and Schedule docs together. Capture red/green evidence for 3 and 5a against unchanged 271401b source. Final handoff collects T1-T4 evidence, all whole-change gates, runtime observation, candidate Compose evidence, CPU medians and security checklist in the PR body. Any topic test splits permitted by the section must be included in the test commands and evidence.
